1de5a8f7ce1a751e.c: Our initiative was born from an authentic passion for automotive modeling on a micro scale. It all began in 2025 – that was when we organized the first edition, held as a ceremonial exhibition combined with a 1:1 scale classic car meet. Even then, modelers from all across Poland gathered beneath the walls of Ogrodzieniec Castle to support our debut.

The success of the inaugural exhibition gave us a clear signal: it was time to shift into a higher gear. In 2026, the first full-fledged competition edition took place, attracting creators specializing in the perfect reproduction of reality. From the beginning, our competition has focused on scale models made of plastic and related materials, maintaining the highest standard of detail.
The second edition of the Meeting was an event open to everyone, not just professionals. We prepared a rich accompanying program:

c: A paradise for collectors and hobbyists. Here you will find rare kits, specialized tools, paints, and accessories to kickstart your journey with this hobby.

Under the guidance of experienced instructors, young enthusiasts could try their hand at assembling their first miniature builds. It was a great opportunity to get hooked on the hobby and develop manual skills and patience.

1de5a8f7ce1a751e.c: We are currently preparing the third edition of the Meeting – not only continuing tradition, but above all evolving. We are expanding the format with new categories and special awards to make it even more appealing to both experienced modelers and visitors.

c: In Ogrodzieniec, passion meets craftsmanship. This is where glossy paint, precision details, and a shared passion for modeling unite people from all over Poland in the shadow of Jurassic rocks.
